data.name: Start
data.comment: Button: starts the match clock at 35:00.

data.name: Stop
data.comment: Button: stops the match clock; no more calls.

data.name: Clock
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the minutes and seconds together; focus rests there after Enter or Esc.

data.name: Minutes
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the clock's minutes field.

data.name: Seconds
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the clock's seconds field.

data.name: MinuteMore
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the arrow above the minutes.

data.name: MinuteLess
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the arrow below the minutes.

data.name: SecondMore
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the arrow above the seconds.

data.name: SecondLess
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the arrow below the seconds.

data.name: Minimize
data.comment: Title bar button.

data.name: Close
data.comment: Title bar button.

data.name: Back
data.comment: Title bar button in Settings: back to the main window.

data.name: Settings
data.comment: The Settings screen's title, the gear button's name, and the link in the status line.

data.name: TestCall
data.comment: Button: whispers the call once, now.

data.name: TestCalling
data.comment: The Test call button while its call plays.

data.name: StatusGroup
data.comment: Status line. {0}: the server group's name.

data.name: StatusChannel
data.comment: Status line, one channel chosen. {0}: its name.

data.name: StatusChannels
data.comment: Status line, several channels chosen. {0}: ChannelCount, such as "3 channels".

data.name: StatusNoListeners
data.value: Connected · choose who hears the calls
data.comment: Status line: connected, but no group or channel chosen. Followed by a Settings link.

data.name: StatusNobodyHeard
data.value: Connected · nobody heard the last call
data.comment: Status line: connected, but the server said the last call reached nobody. No Settings link: the fix is on the server or in the game.

data.name: StatusConnecting
data.comment: Status line. {0}: the server address.

data.name: StatusRaisingIdentity
data.value: Raising the bot’s security level to {0} — can take minutes
data.comment: Status line: the server asks for a stronger identity and Gengfu raises the bot's; each level doubles the time. {0}: the level the server asks for.

data.name: StatusNoAnswer
data.comment: Status line: the server doesn't answer or stopped answering; Gengfu retries by itself. {0}: the server address. {1}: TryingAgainIn or TryingAgainNow.

data.name: StatusAddressNotFound
data.comment: Status line: the address resolves to nothing. {0}: the server address. {1}: TryingAgainIn or TryingAgainNow.

data.name: StatusServerShutdown
data.comment: Status line. {0}: TryingAgainIn or TryingAgainNow.

data.name: StatusKickedByServer
data.comment: Status line: the server itself kicked the bot, as an idle limit does; Gengfu reconnects by itself. {0}: TryingAgainIn or TryingAgainNow.

data.name: StatusServerFull
data.comment: Status line. {0}: TryingAgainIn or TryingAgainNow.

data.name: StatusFloodProtection
data.comment: Status line: the server's flood protection blocks this PC, and Gengfu waits 5 minutes before it tries again. {0}: TryingAgainIn or TryingAgainNow.

data.name: StatusRefused
data.comment: Status line. {0}: the server's own message, often in English. {1}: TryingAgainIn or TryingAgainNow.

data.name: TryingAgainIn
data.comment: Ends a status line while Gengfu waits to try the server again. {0}: the time left, such as 0:25, as the calls list counts to the next call.

data.name: TryingAgainNow
data.comment: Ends a status line while Gengfu tries the server again.

data.name: StatusNotConnected
data.comment: Status line, followed by a Settings link; also the line beside Connect in Settings.

data.name: StatusWrongPassword
data.comment: Status line, followed by a Settings link.

data.name: StatusKicked
data.value: Not connected — kicked from the server
data.comment: Status line, followed by a Settings link.

data.name: StatusBanned
data.value: Not connected — banned from the server
data.comment: Status line, followed by a Settings link.

data.name: StatusLevelTooHigh
data.value: Not connected — server wants security level {0}
data.comment: Status line, followed by a Settings link: the server asks for an identity above the level Gengfu raises to. {0}: the level it asks for.

data.name: StatusNotSetUp
data.comment: Status line before any server is entered, followed by a Settings link.

data.name: PressStart
data.value: Press Start when the match begins
data.comment: Under the clock, before Start.

data.name: MatchTimer
data.comment: Under the clock while a call is next; the calls list shows the call itself.

data.name: In
data.comment: Time left until a call, such as "in 2:13".

data.name: CallingNow
data.comment: Under the clock while a call plays, followed by what it says.

data.name: Gong
data.comment: What a call says when it plays the gong, after CallingNow.

data.name: NoMoreCalls
data.comment: Under the clock after the last call.

data.name: MatchOver
data.comment: Under the clock at 00:00.

data.name: Calls
data.comment: Heading of the calls list and of the Calls card in Settings.

data.name: CallsAhead
data.comment: Beside the calls list's heading. {0}: the lead in seconds.

data.name: Jungle
data.comment: The built-in GvG preset's event name.

data.name: Spawns
data.comment: A call's row. {0}: the spawn's game time, such as 25:00.

data.name: Called
data.comment: Screen-reader name of a made call's check mark.

data.name: Calling
data.comment: A call's row while it plays.

data.name: NotSent
data.comment: A call's row: nobody heard it. It came due while Gengfu couldn't whisper, or the server said it reached nobody, or the clock was moved past its spawn first.

data.name: ServerAddress
data.comment: Settings › TeamSpeak.

data.name: ServerPassword
data.comment: Settings › TeamSpeak.

data.name: Optional
data.comment: Placeholder of the server password.

data.name: BotNickname
data.comment: Settings › TeamSpeak.

data.name: Connect
data.comment: Settings › TeamSpeak: connects with what the fields hold.

data.name: Disconnect
data.comment: Settings › TeamSpeak.

data.name: Connected
data.comment: Beside Disconnect in Settings.

data.name: Connecting
data.comment: Beside Disconnect in Settings.

data.name: WrongPassword
data.comment: Beside Connect in Settings.

data.name: Kicked
data.comment: Beside Connect in Settings.

data.name: Banned
data.comment: Beside Connect in Settings.

data.name: LevelTooHigh
data.comment: Beside Connect in Settings. {0}: the identity level the server asks for.

data.name: WhoHears
data.comment: Settings heading.

data.name: AServerGroup
data.comment: Settings › Who hears the calls: radio button.

data.name: ChosenChannels
data.comment: Settings › Who hears the calls: radio button.

data.name: ConnectFirst
data.comment: The group drop-down before Gengfu has the server's groups.

data.name: ChooseGroup
data.comment: The group drop-down with nothing chosen.

data.name: PickChannels
data.comment: The channels drop-down with nothing chosen.

data.name: ChannelCountOne
data.comment: A count of channels, singular form.

data.name: ChannelCountFew
data.comment: A count of channels; Russian's 2–4 form.

data.name: ChannelCountMany
data.comment: A count of channels; Russian's 5–20 form.

data.name: WhoNoteGroup
data.value: Gengfu whispers, so everyone in the group hears it in whatever channel they are. The server has to allow the bot to whisper.
data.comment: Settings › Who hears the calls, with a server group chosen.

data.name: WhoNoteChannels
data.value: Gengfu whispers, so everyone in the chosen channels hears it. The server has to allow the bot to whisper.
data.comment: Settings › Who hears the calls, with channels chosen.

data.name: CallAhead
data.comment: Settings › Calls: how long before each spawn a call goes out.

data.name: SecondsCount
data.comment: A lead on offer: 15, 20, 30, 45 or 60.

data.name: Say
data.comment: Settings › Calls: the call's text.

data.name: CallText15
data.comment: The call's default text with a 15 s lead; spoken by a Windows voice.

data.name: CallText20
data.comment: The call's default text with a 20 s lead.

data.name: CallText30
data.comment: The call's default text with a 30 s lead.

data.name: CallText45
data.comment: The call's default text with a 45 s lead.

data.name: CallText60
data.comment: The call's default text with a 60 s lead.

data.name: Voice
data.comment: Settings › Calls.

data.name: GongNoVoice
data.comment: First entry of the voice list.

data.name: NoVoice
data.value: Windows has no English voice, so calls play a gong. Add one in Language & region › English › Language options, or pick another language’s voice and write the text in it.
data.comment: Hint under Voice when no voice speaks the app's language. Name Windows' own labels.

data.name: OpenLanguageRegion
data.comment: Link in the no-voice hint; opens Windows Settings.

data.name: NoText
data.value: There is nothing to say, so calls play a gong.
data.comment: Hint under Voice when Say is empty.

data.name: SpeechFailed
data.value: Windows couldn’t speak the text, so calls play a gong.
data.comment: Hint under Voice when the voice failed.

data.name: SoundFile
data.comment: Settings › Calls, in place of Say and Voice.

data.name: Change
data.comment: Button beside the sound file: pick another.

data.name: FileUnreadable
data.value: Windows can’t play this file, so calls play a gong. Pick another, such as an MP3 or WAV.
data.comment: Hint under the sound file.

data.name: UseSoundFile
data.comment: Link in Settings › Calls.

data.name: UseText
data.comment: Link in Settings › Calls while a sound file is chosen.

data.name: NobodyHeardGroup
data.value: Nobody heard the last call. Either no one in the group is online, or the server doesn’t allow the bot to whisper to them.
data.comment: Caution under Test call in Settings › Calls once the server said the last call reached nobody, with a server group chosen.

data.name: NobodyHeardChannels
data.value: Nobody heard the last call. Either no one is in the chosen channels, or the server doesn’t allow the bot to whisper to them.
data.comment: The same caution, with channels chosen.

data.name: ChooseSoundFile
data.comment: Title of Windows' file picker.

data.name: SoundFiles
data.comment: File type in Windows' file picker.

data.name: AllFiles
data.comment: File type in Windows' file picker.

data.name: General
data.comment: Settings heading.

data.name: Language
data.comment: Settings › General.

data.name: SameAsWindows
data.comment: Settings › General › Language and Theme: the default.

data.name: Theme
data.comment: Settings › General.

data.name: Light
data.comment: Settings › General › Theme.

data.name: Dark
data.comment: Settings › General › Theme.

data.name: OpenSettingsFile
data.comment: Link in Settings › General and in the settings-file bar; opens settings.json in an editor.

data.name: SettingsFileError
data.value: settings.json has an error on line {0} ({1}). Until it’s fixed, Gengfu works with the settings shown here and saves nothing.
data.comment: Bar at the top of Settings. {0} is a line number, {1} a setting as the file spells it, such as "events[1].spawns".

data.name: SettingsFileErrorOnLine
data.value: settings.json has an error on line {0}. Until it’s fixed, Gengfu works with the settings shown here and saves nothing.
data.comment: Bar at the top of Settings, for an error outside any setting, such as a missing comma. {0} is a line number.

data.name: SettingsFileUnreadable
data.value: Gengfu can’t read settings.json. Until it can, Gengfu works with the settings shown here and saves nothing.
data.comment: Bar at the top of Settings, when Windows won't let Gengfu read the file.

data.name: UpdateReady
data.value: Update installed — it applies the next time Gengfu starts.
data.comment: The main window's notice once a new version has downloaded; it shows only while the clock is stopped.

data.name: Restart
data.comment: The update notice's button: closes Gengfu, applies the update and opens Gengfu again.

data.name: UpdateChecking
data.comment: Settings › General, under the version: the first look for a new version since Gengfu started.

data.name: UpToDate
data.value: Up to date · updates install on their own
data.comment: Settings › General, under the version.

data.name: UpdateDownloading
data.comment: Settings › General, under the version. {0} is the new version, such as "0.1.1".

data.name: UpdateInstalled
data.value: Version {0} installed · applies the next time Gengfu starts
data.comment: Settings › General, under the version. {0} is the new version, such as "0.1.1".

data.name: UpdateCheckFailed
data.value: Couldn’t check for updates — trying again later
data.comment: Settings › General, under the version: the last look failed, offline perhaps; the next comes on schedule.
